howToEnroll.title: How to Enroll
howToEnroll.introHeading: Interested in joining the Segue community?
howToEnroll.introBody: Visit this page for enrollment forms, eligibility details, deadlines, and application requirements.
howToEnroll.step1Body: Visit the EnrollRI Common Application portal, powered by the Rhode Island Department of Education. First-time users should click "Create an Account" to begin. Returning users can log in using the same email or mobile number previously used, even if it was for a different school or All Course Network application.
howToEnroll.step2Title: Step 2: Add Students and Select Segue
howToEnroll.step2Body: Once logged in, use "Add a Student" if your child is not already listed under your account. Then start your application and be sure to select:
step2Items: Segue Institute for Learning for grades K-8 within Central Falls
Legacy High School for grades 9-12 (eligible from Central Falls, Providence, Pawtucket, and Woonsocket)
howToEnroll.step3Title: Step 3: Apply Before the Lottery Deadline
howToEnroll.step3Body: The lottery application for the 2025-26 school year opened November 19, 2024 at 9 AM and closed March 13, 2025 at 5 PM. If there were more applicants than seats, a random lottery drawing took place on April 1, 2025. Families who apply on time are automatically entered into the lottery pool. If you missed the deadline, a Post-Lottery Application becomes available starting April 15, 2025.
howToEnroll.step4Title: Step 4: Submit and Review Your Application
howToEnroll.step4Body: You can update or edit your application, including changing school choices, up until the deadline. Once submitted and accepted into the lottery, Segue staff will contact you if your child is offered a seat.
howToEnroll.step5Body: The lottery is a public event held at the Segue school building. Active applicants are notified via phone or postcard. Those not offered a spot may be placed on a waitlist and contacted if space becomes available.
checklist: Create or log in to your EnrollRI account
Add your child and select Segue Institute or Legacy High School
Edit your application if needed before the deadline
Wait for lottery results and follow next steps based on outcome

formsAndDeadlines.title: Forms and Deadlines
formsAndDeadlines.intro: Below you'll find important forms, application portals, and key dates for enrollment at Segue Institute for Learning and Legacy High School.
formsAndDeadlines.portalBody: Use the EnrollRI Common Application to apply. First-time users must create an account; returning users can log in with their existing credentials.
formsAndDeadlines.drawingBody: Held publicly at Segue on April 1, 2025. Families are notified by phone or postcard.
formsAndDeadlines.postLotteryBody: Open starting April 15, 2025 for late applicants. Waitlist offers may follow as space becomes available.
requiredItems: Segue Institute for Learning - Grades K-8 (Central Falls)
Legacy High School - Grades 9-12 (Available to students from Central Falls, Providence, Pawtucket, and Woonsocket)

admissionsAndLottery.title: Admissions and Lottery
admissionsAndLottery.howToApplyIntro: Families can request an application by:
admissionsAndLottery.howToApplyOutro: Applications are provided in both English and Spanish and may be submitted electronically.
admissionsAndLottery.deadline: Application Deadline: February 15th (to be included in the lottery)
admissionsAndLottery.lotteryProcessBody: When the number of applicants exceeds the number of available seats, Segue conducts a random public lottery in accordance with Rhode Island Department of Education guidance.

equalOpportunity.title: Equal Opportunity Statement
equalOpportunity.p1: Segue Institute for Learning is committed to maintaining a work and learning environment free from discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, pregnancy, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or civil union status, ancestry, place of birth, age, citizenship status, veteran status, political affiliation, genetic information, or disability—as defined and required by state and federal law.
equalOpportunity.p2: We also strictly prohibit retaliation against individuals who oppose such discrimination or who participate in any related investigation.

complaint.title: To file a complaint of discrimination, contact:
complaint.line1: USDA, Director, Office of Civil Rights

lottery.title: Lottery Exemptions
siblings: Siblings (as defined by shared legal guardian or parent) may be exempt from the lottery and admitted directly, provided they do not exceed 10% of the school’s total enrollment. If more siblings apply than there are spaces, a separate pre-lottery will be conducted for sibling applicants.

Children of founding families may be admitted directly, provided they do not exceed 10% of the school’s total enrollment. If more apply than there are spaces, a separate pre-lottery will be conducted for founding family children.
